summary: node1 now persistently uses os-lab.infra.test and resolves it locally to 127.0.1.1. The configuration survived a verified node reboot. An unrelated pre-existing ssh.service failure remains due to missing SSH host keys.

Updated /etc/hosts with os-lab.infra.test and os-lab aliases.
Verified hostname and local resolution before reboot.

evidence.summary: Runtime, static, and /etc/hostname values all equal os-lab.infra.test, including after reboot.
/etc/hosts maps the FQDN to 127.0.1.1, and getent resolution succeeded before and after reboot.

Healthy task baseline used boot ID 8e0ddb92-5f82-4d03-942e-362c27d766cd; the reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID 1faf62df-7632-4ee2-9580-2212f731980c; hostname, resolver data, and multi-user target recovered.
